Parasom- nias are motor disorders, with or without autonomic fea- tures, that occur during sleep or are exaggerated by sleep. Some of the main parasomnias include nightmares, night terrors, sleepwalking (somnambulism), nocturnal enuresis (p.2180), bruxism (teeth grinding), head banging, and ag- gression during sleep.
